body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Skullcandy, a developer of core audio products, launched its new division of audio electronics '2XL' during 2009 CES.

A bold and unique line of headphones and audio accessories rooted in lifestyle and culture, the 2XL offers today's generation "individual style with universal appeal", including a level of unprecedented self expression and diversity.
